cosmos-graph.js — vendored @cosmos.gl/graph bundle
====================================================

Package
    @cosmos.gl/graph@3.1.0  (npm dist-tag "latest" as of 2026-07-04)

Global name exposed by the bundle
    Cosmos
    (window.Cosmos.Graph is the constructor CP2 consumes; other named
    exports — PointShape, TransitionEasing, clamp, defaultConfigValues,
    extractIndicesFromPixels, focusedPointRingOpacity, getMaxPointSize,
    getRgbaColor, hoveredPointRingOpacity, isAClassInstance, isArray,
    isFunction, isNumber, isObject, isPlainObject, readPixels,
    rgbToBrightness, sanitizeHtml — are also attached to window.Cosmos)

Bundler
    esbuild 0.28.1 (pinned via `npx esbuild@0.28.1`)

Exact command
    mkdir /tmp/cosmos-bundle && cd /tmp/cosmos-bundle
    npm init -y
    npm install @cosmos.gl/graph@3.1.0
    echo "export * from '@cosmos.gl/graph';" > entry.js
    npx --yes esbuild@0.28.1 entry.js --bundle --format=iife \
        --global-name=Cosmos --minify --outfile=cosmos-graph.js

    ab5db62d5d85f3cf60d6707cf1bc476627ba8fa7ad7c8632b03263c895e7aa05

Output size
    816715 bytes (~798 KiB)

Verification performed at bundling time
    Node smoke-load: `node -e` loaded cosmos-graph.js via vm.runInThisContext
    and confirmed `typeof Cosmos === "object"` and `typeof Cosmos.Graph ===
    "function"`. WebGL2 is unavailable in Node, so no Graph instance was
    constructed — that requires a browser context (verified manually in
    checkpoint 2/3 of this feature).

To reproduce or re-vendor
    Re-run the exact command above with a newer @cosmos.gl/graph version
    and/or esbuild version, update the version/checksum/pins in this file,
    and replace cosmos-graph.js. Never hand-edit cosmos-graph.js.
